spec_match.rationale: Uses \A…\z and \A…\Z as whole-input validators under the m flag, and the HTML pattern attribute's v-flag compilation, as the explainer's portability motivation describes.

interactive.rationale: Six sample buttons and a free-text field (with escape interpretation) re-validate; two buttons attach real pattern attributes and read validity.patternMismatch.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card's smuggled-line, \Z-leniency and ignored-pattern claims are each observable on the page.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers LF, CR LF and header-injection values, trailing-terminator leniency, and an invalid pattern attribute silently disabling validation.

references.rationale: See-also links chromestatus.com/feature/5187917373898752, the TC39 spec and explainer sections the page relies on.

conformance.rationale: Behaviour matches the A-ignores-multiline, z-ignores-multiline and Z-one-trailing-line-terminator assertions.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 via Playwright (chrome-devtools-mcp is not available in this environment, so this is NOT DevTools-MCP verification), run in two modes: default and --js-flags=--js-regexp-buffer-boundaries. Every control was exercised at 1280x800 and at 360x740 (DPR 3, touch). Document overflow was 0px in both classes and modes, every control was at least 44px tall, and full-page screenshots were read. Default: the \A rows run the labelled fallback; pattern="\A…\z" gives patternMismatch=false (not enforced) and Chrome logs the expected 'Pattern attribute value … is not a valid regular expression' console error after the click. Flagged: patternMismatch=true, and 'alice\n<script>' is accepted by ^…$ but rejected by both buffer validators.

design_system.rationale: Uses only the public/styles.css variables via the shared bb.css. Buttons set both background and color; status colours are emerald-dark/rose on stone.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons, radios, checkboxes and selects with visible labels in fieldset/legend; aria-pressed on preset buttons; polite live verdicts; 3px focus outlines; tables use caption and scope inside a focusable region. The accessibility tree was not inspected with DevTools MCP, which is unavailable here.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Both classes driven in both engine modes: 0px document overflow, 44px targets, single-column stages; wide tables scroll inside a labelled focusable region.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify on a Chrome 159 build where the feature is on by default or staged
openQuestions.detail: Verified only on Chrome 153 with --js-flags=--js-regexp-buffer-boundaries. Confirm that chrome://flags/#enable-javascript-harmony enables it once V8 marks it staged (V8 main has it in FOREACH_STAGED_FEATURE_FLAG), then update the banner when it ships by default.

openQuestions.title: Expected console error on the unsupported pattern-attribute path
openQuestions.detail: In engines without the feature, attaching pattern="\A…\z" makes Chrome log a console error (user-initiated). Decide whether the weekly zero-console-error gate should whitelist it, or whether the demo should first test-compile with new RegExp(…, 'v') and skip attaching.

openQuestions.title: No chrome-devtools-mcp verification
openQuestions.detail: Runtime evidence comes from headless Playwright Chrome 153, not DevTools MCP; accessibility-tree inspection is still outstanding.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible text input textarea labels validation feedback
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Visible <label for> on every control, hints via aria-describedby, no placeholder-only labels.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every input/textarea/select has a visible label; hints use aria-describedby; flags/radios are grouped in fieldset+legend.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible text input textarea labels validation feedback
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Defer error styling to :user-invalid after interaction.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Considered; the validator's verdicts are the demo's output rather than form errors, so they are shown explicitly on every input. The pattern-attribute section reads validity.patternMismatch directly.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible data table responsive small screens
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Semantic table with caption and scope headers inside a role=region, tabindex=0, aria-labelledby wrapper that scrolls; sticky row headers.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All result tables use caption, th scope, region wrapper with tabindex and a sticky row-header column; the page itself has 0px overflow at 360px (the table scrolls inside its region).

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live region announce async result status
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use aria-live polite for standard result updates; reserve assertive for critical; debounce noisy regions.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Engine and result verdicts are polite live regions; typing-driven updates are debounced 120-150ms; tables are not live (the verdict summarises them).

summary: A practical security-flavoured demo: m-flag allow-lists leak, \A…\z closes the leak, and \Z re-opens a trailing CR LF. It also shows a real, surprising HTML consequence: an unsupported \A pattern attribute disables validation.
